name: Nova: Synthesis Creaturum
source:
For years now, monsters have been a growing problem in Diolacov Kingdom. Their origin and behavior are a mystery, and a solution to control them has yet to be found. One day in the forest, novice magic student Merona encounters a monster while collecting plant life for study. At a crucial moment, she somehow manages to save herself by turning the monster into an innocent animal! How did she do that? What did she do? Merona is then sent on a journey by her academy with a team of companions to travel over the forests of the kingdom to discover more about monsters and how she can transform them. What lies ahead is much more than what everyone had expected…

[From [url=http://nova-sc.itch.io/novascofficial]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
多年来，怪物一直是迪奥拉科夫王国日益严重的问题。它们的起源和行为都是谜，至今仍未找到控制它们的方法。某天，初级魔法学生梅罗娜在森林里采集植物进行研究时遇到了一只怪物。关键时刻，她不知怎的将怪物变成了一只无害的动物，救了自己！她是怎么做到的？做了什么？随后，学院派她与同伴组成队伍，踏上穿越王国森林的旅程，调查更多关于怪物的事情，并研究她如何将它们变形。前方等待他们的，远比所有人预想的更多……

[摘自[url=http://nova-sc.itch.io/novascofficial]Itch.io[/url]]
